name: drug-list-tab
does: A Drug list tab over the course's DRUG_TABLES (a data file listed in course.js `files`): one table per page or section under its title, with its legend; group chips (the option `groups`, plus All pages) that narrow the tables shown; a search across every table, not only the chosen group's; a tap or Enter on a row opens the row's detail field split into its sections (key side effects, boxed warnings, other notes), tapped again to close; a jump strip to each table; a page-image view when every table gives an image. A Recall mode (from DEENT's drug list): each row shows only the fields named in recallShow, with a writing box and a Reveal button under it, Show class, Reveal all shown and Hide all. The choices and what is typed last for the visit only; nothing is stored.
source: BDK assets/app.js viewBrowse (lines 2553-2618), QUIZZES (line 42), ekHtml (lines 882-899), resolveSeeAbove (lines 331-347), assets/style.css (lines 105, 262-276, 327-338, 355-356, 397-401) and tests/ui.js (lines 7-28), at 05c36c3; recall mode from DEENT src/druglist_ui.js (lines 31-32, 70-71, 160-174, 203-206, 209, 236, 248-253, 256-259) at 0281922

label.about: the tab's name in the nav and its heading

before.about: the tab it is placed before

intro.about: a line under the heading (BDK: its list's edition, then "page by page. Pick a quiz to see only its pages."); empty: none

columns.about: the table's columns, in order: [field, heading] or [field, heading, sub-field, sub-label], the sub-field printed under the cell after its label when the row has it (BDK's)

searchFields.about: the row fields the search looks in (BDK's)

detailField.about: the row field a tap on the row opens, split at the labels of detailSections

detailSections.about: the sections of the detail field, in the order shown: heading ({s} becomes s for more than one entry or a plural label), label (a regular expression without capturing groups, matched without case, followed by an optional (qualifier) and a colon), warn (shown as a warning); empty: the field is shown as one paragraph

detailOwnField.about: the row field that names the row's drug (BDK: generic): a section qualified with a drug of the same table, such as "(only for ketorolac)", is shown only on rows whose field holds every word of the qualifier; empty: every section on every row. A heuristic tuned on BDK's data (it gives each of BDK's 300 rows the sections its flashcards give it): a qualifier counts as naming a drug only when its first word, after "only for", is the first word of that field on a row of the same table, and the row must hold every word of the qualifier, so a qualifier such as "(only for X and Y)" or one using an abbreviation hides the section from the rows it names

detailSeeAbove.about: a regular expression without capturing groups, matched without case at the start of a qualified section's text (BDK: See above): such a section shows instead the texts of the same section and qualifier on every other row of every table that do not start so, in the data's order without repeats (BDK resolveSeeAbove); empty: off

noDetail.about: what the detail row says when the row's detail field is empty

groups.about: the group chips: [{label, tables: [table ids] | 'all'}] (BDK: its quizzes and their pages); empty: no chips

defaultGroup.about: the label of the group the tab opens on; empty: All pages

headTag.about: the tag beside each table's title and on a chip's table list: {id} and {short} are replaced (BDK: p{id})

rowNote.default: Tap a row for essential knowledge.
rowNote.about: the line under the search box; empty: none

imageLabel.about: the name of the page-image view, offered only when every table gives an image

recallDefault.about: whether the tab opens in recall mode (DEENT opens its list with recall on); false: the list opens as BDK's does, and the Recall mode chip turns it on

recallShow.about: the row fields recall mode keeps visible; every other cell is drawn empty until the row is revealed. In recall mode the search looks only in these fields and recallClassField (DEENT's findText: name, other names, brands, class)

recallClassField.about: the field the Show class chip shows on every row in recall mode (DEENT's Show class); empty: no Show class chip

recallPrompt.default: Write what you recall first (self-check: not graded, not saved)
recallPrompt.about: the label of each row's writing box in recall mode (adapted from DEENT's "Write the target or mechanism first (self-check: not graded, not saved)")
